_comment: Per-skill, per-level recipe unlocks. Schema: { "skills": { "<capability_id_lower>": { "<level>": ["item_id", ...] } } }. A villager may craft the union of every (skill, level) whose capability level it has reached. Gate is the UNLOCK SET, not a generic CRAFTING level — e.g. a Farmer with FARMING=3 unlocks farming levels 1..3 (bread, hoe, seeds, pumpkin pie, cookies) even with CRAFTING=0. Level 1 always includes starter essentials (seeds + hoe for farmers). Levels follow the vanilla trade tiers where one exists (1=novice ... 5=master). Items with no vanilla recipe (e.g. minecraft:wheat_seeds) must also be added to custom_recipes.json.
